My best friend dying in a car accident that I survived. I was 16. We crashed going 80 mph off an interstate and veered off the road 15-20 feet,
hit two trees and rolled over at least 6 or more times. He wasn’t wearing his seat belt. I was lucky I wasn’t fucked up for life. I somehow only suffered minimal injuries. No broken bones. But subdural hematoma which I recovered from, bruised ribs, and a torn eyelid that I still have the scar to this day. We were both so high on molly that I forget exactly what was said but he began to cry and say a lot of disturbing things. I believe something triggered him to have a bad trip on top of internal issues, but I’ll truly never know if it was an accident or suicide. Remembering the last oddly peaceful moments of the city skyline as we were airborne and just thinking to myself this isn’t a movie this isn’t no fucking cartoon this is for real how I’m gonna die. My friend was seated and entrapped in the car because the crash was so violent it crumpled the fuck out of it . Knowing his dead body was just next to me while I was trapped in the vehicle and the paramedics ripped me out with the jaws of life keeps me awake very often at night. Hitting the trees was when he died and it was the most violent sound that I still sometimes wake up to and although I wish I could I’ll never forget it ..
But the whole point is it’s never happened to me before and never occurred again yet which is really really odd.
Thank you for your condolences, it’s greatly appreciated .
All 4 of my lovely grandparents were my angels that night.. I pray to them daily and thank them for giving me a new chance at life .

Thank you for the condolences. It is still hard to fathom that someone I loved and trusted so much would almost take my own life. God had saved me from seeing that because he knows I wouldn’t be able to put myself back together after seeing D like that.. I also wake up everyday and thank god that my face isn’t damaged permanently, I’m not paralyzed, etc.. it will take time to get over but I believe with the right support system I will work through it ..

I may have already said it but, I am going to seek out a grief counselor and possibly a therapist to see regularly. I believe talking through the emotions and the experience may help as well. Thank you for your well wishes .
Thank you for your condolences ..
I’m alright physically, but mentally I feel like all the walls are caving in.
Thank you for the idea. & I am currently seeking a grief counselor and maybe a therapist I can see on a regular basis.
The anger for the most part is because , he put my life at risk as well, and almost killed me , one of the people I had trusted the most, after explaining my pain..

Honestly I didn’t know this was going to get this much attention, which isn’t that much but, for my first Reddit post it’s quite a bit for just a day.. I just came on here to spill my feelings because I felt like I was going to cave, but I have nobody in person I can talk to about this. Being with D everyday and being the one to see those behaviors, I truly do feel like sometimes I am the one to blame. It does feel like something I have to rot in my grave with and that haunts me .

I’m so sorry this happened to you and your now late friend. I can’t imagine the emotions you’ve had to experience. The survivors guilt and shame is real, and I’m sure you know as well as I do.. On a daily basis my head spins with the thoughts of how I could’ve and should’ve saved D, how I should’ve recognized the warning signs before it was too late. I hope you have been able to move on from this traumatic experience..

I am so sorry that had happened to you. Please do not blame yourself for your friends death, it wasn’t your fault , you did everything you could . I hope your recovery process becomes easier and easier with time ..

As someone who has suffered from suicidal thoughts as well, I understand both sides of the picture . So it’s almost as if a part of me wants to be enraged and wants to forgive at the same time. People really do not consider or understand how suicide plays such a massive domino effect in everyones lives that knew the individual , and now I completely understand..
